state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stages 2 and 3 are on disk: comparison, hashing, placeholders and the palette. Stages 4 (QR codes), 5 (text) and 6 (the feature proofs) are not.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets, the crates included. No session re-decides one.

Stage 3 on disk: the component's `hash`, `placeholder` and `palette` exports (`extensions/image/src/hash.rs`, `extensions/image/src/summary.rs`, whose module docs define them), the manifest's `Codec::placeholder`, `Codec::palette` and `PlaceholderKind`, `Image::placeholder` and `Image::palette` in `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs`, the host checks in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs` and the `image-hash-*` / `image-placeholder-*` cases under `tests/conformance/novis/`. BlurHash and ThumbHash are written in the component with no crate, as the hashes are, so `cargo deny` and the third-party notice did not move; the palette uses `color_quant` (already in the component's lock, now a direct dependency). `rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`'s *Not shipped* paragraph says what is on disk.

The component's own unit tests run with `cargo test --lib` inside `extensions/image/`, a workspace of its own.

next.title: QR codes
next.note: one file set: `extensions/image/src/lib.rs`, a new `extensions/image/src/qr.rs`, `extensions/image/Cargo.toml`, `extensions/image/manifest.json`, `wit/image.wit`, a new `extensions/image/nvs/QrCode.nvs`, and the record's QR check file under `crates/nvs-ext/tests/`.

items.text: **The `qr` export** (`rule:core-classes/image-one-entry-point-per-job`, ADR 0120 § 9) — wired in at `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:700`, its options at `wit/image.wit:293`: render through the `qrcode` crate (check it with `cargo deny` and the third-party notice, or write the encoder in the component if it does not build for `wasm32-wasip2`), encode as PNG or the options' format, and follow `summary.rs`'s split of a core function with host unit tests.

**`QrCode::render` and `QrLevel`** — a new `extensions/image/nvs/QrCode.nvs` beside `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:338`, and the manifest's `qr` entry and `QrLevel` enum; `size` and `margin` set the image size.

**The QR checks** — the record's `nvs-ext` QR test `a_qr_code_renders_and_decodes_back_to_its_data` (read the record for its `--test` file; `rqrr` is a dev-dependency there only), and `tests/conformance/novis/image-a-qr-code-is-a-square-png.nvst`, next to `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_analysis.rs:460`.

backlog: Stage 5, text: `Font::fromBytes` in Novis, `Image::text` and `Image::measureText` over `ab_glyph` (goal record's stage 5 checks).
Stage 6: `bun nv proofs --only` reported the goal's members as not on the roster before they existed (`tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts`); re-run it once the members land and write each proof it names.
`extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs` has four comments `bun nv proofs --comments` names (lines 55, 118, 158, 376), all older than this goal's members; stage 6 rewrites them.
The once-per-`Image` claim for `compare` has no harness that counts crossings from Novis.
